items.q: How long does a website take?
items.a: A typical business website takes 2–4 weeks. Larger web apps and e-commerce sites take longer — we'll give you a clear timeline before we start.

items.q: How much does a project cost?
items.a: See our fixed-price packages above. If you need something custom, we send a fixed quote after a short call — no hidden costs.

items.q: Which platforms do you build apps for?
items.a: We build Android apps and handle publishing to Google Play for you.

items.q: Will I be able to update my website myself?
items.a: Yes. We can add an easy content management system and show you how to use it.

items.q: Do you offer support after launch?
items.a: Yes. We offer maintenance plans covering updates, backups, security and small changes.
